maddeler.e:
يزدجر (form VIII)
# يَزْدَجِرُ (yazdajiru) /jaz.da.d͡ʒi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# يُزْدَجَرُ (yuzdajaru) /juz.da.d͡ʒa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# يَزْدَجِرَ (yazdajira) /jaz.da.d͡ʒi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
